generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: An open two-sided semantic classifier is tuned until a stable holdout passes, but unseen members from either class can still cross the decision boundary.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Use a fixed positive/negative fixture corpus to calibrate literals, stems, regexes, scores or thresholds and treat that same corpus as proof of generalization.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: After the final material tuning, execute a fresh disjoint bidirectional shadow set plus a separate cross-family transfer set; any subsequent tuning invalidates those shadow results.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Independently choose new members on both sides after implementation freeze, prove they are disjoint from production discriminator literals and development calibration fixtures, then execute the real boundary and inspect score margins when present.

transfer_cases.evidence: generic prevention contract test requires post-tuning shadow and transfer sets
generic detection contract test requires independently selected bidirectional members
